svg.title: favbase turns favorites from six sources into a local knowledge base
svg.desc: Bilibili Favorites, GitHub Stars, Browser Bookmarks, X Bookmarks, Zhihu Favorites, and YouTube Playlists flow into the yellow knowledge star held by the blue favbase squirrel.

g.text: Collect what you saved into one local knowledge base.
Search it, ask it, and return to every original source.
